verification_candidates.claim_text: Taking broad-spectrum antibiotics for minor illnesses like coughs and colds kills off the gut microbiome.

verification_candidates.evidence_quote: most probiotics are pretty worthless because they're not protected from acid in the stomach or bile
verification_candidates.rationale: Whether most oral probiotics survive gastric transit is a checkable claim about supplement efficacy.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Probiotics will not survive or function in the gut without adequate soluble fiber (prebiotics) to feed them.

verification_candidates.rationale: Whether probiotic survival depends on co-consuming prebiotic fiber is a checkable mechanistic claim.

verification_candidates.rationale: Whether leaky gut causes weakened immunity is a checkable causal claim.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Humans are biologically not adapted to social distancing because interpersonal touch and connection are built into human nature.
